script.base: TB at DAL, Week 5. Spread and total are not in the pack, so this TB @ DAL script is form-only and does not name a book favorite or a points total. The Dallas Cowboys are the pass engine: CeeDee Lamb 39 targets and 454 receiving yards over weeks 2-4, Dak Prescott EPA/dropback +0.32 when not blitzed and +0.13 vs blitz (n=52). The Tampa Bay Buccaneers run through Bucky Irving (48 carries, 196 yards in those three games) while Baker Mayfield's EPA is negative in both splits (-0.18 vs blitz on 62 dropbacks, -0.23 clean). The DAL run defense is the soft unit (4.93 YPC, 15 runs of 10+) and the TB defense is the stingy one (3.58 YPC, 8 runs of 10+, 9 passes of 20+ on 130 attempts). Base flow for TB @ DAL: competitive, Tampa Bay leans run to stay attached, Dallas throws to try to lead. No pack evidence for a blowout or a shootout.
script.flip1: Dallas Cowboys get up early on the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. TB abandons the run, Bucky Irving falls off his 16-carry L3 pace, and Mayfield is pushed into more dropbacks against a DAL defense that blitzes only 27%, which is his worse EPA split (-0.23). DAL can grind clock after that, but the TB run defense at 3.58 YPC caps how efficient that grind is.
script.flip2: Tampa Bay controls the clock on the ground against the Dallas 4.93 YPC front, Dak Prescott's possessions shrink, and Lamb's 13-target pace does not get a full game. Irving's TB rushing line is helped; Tampa Bay receivers, including Cade Otton, see fewer routes.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Tampa Bay RB Bucky Irving is the TB run game (48 carries, 196 yards over the last three) and the Dallas Cowboys are allowing 4.93 yards per carry with 15 runs of 10+, so a 53-yard rush line sits under both his recent TB role and the DAL matchup.
edge_players.must_be_true: TB still gives Irving about 14 carries, DAL does not jump to an early lead that forces Tampa Bay off the run, and he is not on a snap limit the pack cannot see.
edge_players.kills_it: Dallas leads big and Tampa Bay throws, or the TB Daniels 43.5 rush main line is right and Irving's carries fall into a committee (12 carries at 4.0 YPC is 48, under 53).

edge_players.edge_sentence: Tampa Bay TE Cade Otton is the TB leading receiver over the last three (18 targets, 131 yards) and the Dallas passing soft spot is the middle at 11.62 YPA, which is the area a 7.2-aDOT tight end attacks, with a 30.5 line under his 44-yard recent pace.
edge_players.must_be_true: TB keeps Otton at a 5-plus target share, Tampa Bay does not spend the whole game in a two-back clock grind against Dallas, and Mayfield's negative EPA does not wipe out the intermediate completions.
edge_players.kills_it: Tampa Bay controls the clock and Otton drops to 3-4 targets, or Dallas takes the tight end away and the TB air yards stay with Hurst (243), Egbuka (184) and Johnson (216), who have not been converting them into yards.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both TB legs lost at Dallas. The Dallas Cowboys led by two scores at half, Tampa Bay threw, and Bucky Irving finished with 11 carries under 53 because TB back Jalon Daniels, priced at 43.5, took the change-of-pace and short-yardage work the L3 box score did not show. Cade Otton saw targets but Mayfield's -0.23 clean-pocket EPA showed up against a DAL 27% blitz team, the Dallas middle 11.62 YPA was a 24-attempt sample that did not travel, and the TB pass plan was Hurst, Egbuka and Johnson air yards, leaving Otton in the low 20s. A late scratch or snap limit not in the pack for either team would have done the same thing. Weather was not saved; wind of 15+ would have helped the TB rusher and hurt the TB tight end, so this pair was never one-weather.
slip_story: One TB @ DAL story: the Tampa Bay Buccaneers attack the two places the Dallas Cowboys actually bleed, the run and the middle, in a competitive game. TB Irving rush over and TB Otton receiving over win together if Tampa Bay has a real offense and does not have to pick one phase. Do not add a game-total under, a DAL Lamb under, or a DAL Williams rush over; those need a different script. Irving is script-dependent on Tampa Bay not trailing big; Otton is script-dependent on Tampa Bay not purely clock-killing. No TD legs and no second market on either player.
